note: BASELINE AUTHORING (kit-autonomy gauntlet 2026-07-28) — 2B (`2b`, AR/Defender/Fire/Burst III, cd 40s, ammo 90 / reloadFrames 81, NieR:Automata collab, no base counterpart). First modeling; ground truth is the top-level prose (data/characters.json → characters['2b'].skills). Her damage identity is a single load-bearing SYNERGY: S1 stacks Max HP on every burst cast, and S2's passive converts final Max HP into ATK, so the more she bursts the harder every hit lands — the escalating Max HP ladder is OFFENSIVELY LIVE for her (unlike a pure Defender HP grant) precisely because she is her own atkOfMaxHpPct consumer. SKILL1 ('Activates when using Burst Skill. Affects self. Effects vary according to the number of times used. Each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it: Once: Max HP ▲10.03% / Twice: ▲20.06% / Three times: ▲57.76% continuously') = burstCast → self `escalating` steps [targetMaxHpPct 10.03 / 20.06 / 57.76], the canonical Liter-style cumulative-with-cap ladder (sim.ts escalating case applies steps 1..min(N,3) on the Nth activation, exactly matching 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'): 1st burst +10.03%, 2nd +10.03+20.06, 3rd+ capped at 10.03+20.06+57.76 = 87.85% Max HP. targetMaxHpPct ('Max HP ▲ X%' — the target's OWN %) is the literal-word stat (vs casterMaxHpPct '% of the skill user's Max HP'); self-targeted so caster===target and the grant arrives as an OWN-kit maxHpFlat (casterIdx===self) that effectiveAtk's e3 rule feeds into her atkOfMaxHpPct conversion (sim.ts:1472-1498). Duration-less ('continuously') = permanent once applied; the three distinct values key three distinct maxHpFlat buffs that stack and refresh (no infinite re-stack), identical to Liter's validated escalating buffs. SKILL2 block A ('Activates after firing 300 time(s). Affects all enemies. Deals 167.45% of final ATK as damage') = hitCount:300 → enemy flatDamage 167.45 — RECURRING (the engine's hitCount fires every 300 cumulative hits; AR hitsPerShot 1 ⇒ every 300 shots), 'all enemies' collapses to the single immortal boss. SKILL2 block B ('Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. ATK ▲ 6.16% of the skill user's final Max HP continuously') = passive → self atkOfMaxHpPct 6.16 — 'final Max HP' = live Max HP (base + own-kit maxHpFlat stacks), read per-frame in effectiveAtk, so the S1 ladder grows this ATK add dynamically. BURST block A ('Affects all enemies. Deals 2439.36% of final ATK as distributed damage') = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 2439.36 flavor distributed ('all enemies' → the boss; distributed split is inert single-target). BURST block B ('Affects 1 enemy unit(s) with the highest remaining HP. Deals 792% of final ATK as additional damage') = burstCast → enemy flatDamage 792 ('highest remaining HP' selection collapses to the single boss). Cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens (instant burst, ulti skill_type InstantNumber), so neither burst hit takes the +50% FB major (verified fact 2026-07-13, helm/exia precedent). ⚑1 cluster-bomb cadence: recurring-every-300-shots is the engine hitCount convention; if the real kit is a ONE-TIME 300-shot trigger the fight would carry exactly 1 proc instead of ~6 — board A/B (or a focus video popup count) is the discriminator. ⚑2 crit: all three damage hits are encoded NON-crit (the flatDamage default; helm/exia burst-nuke precedent) — absent a measurement that 2B's skill/burst procs crit, non-crit is the conservative faithful default; a measured crit rate would opt the hits in via crit:true. ⚑3 S1 ladder additive-vs-latest: encoded additive (steps sum to 87.85% at 3 stacks) per the Liter-validated escalating reading of 'each subsequent effect triggers all effects before it'; if the real kit applies only the LATEST line (57.76% cap) the ATK conversion is ~30% smaller — the cross-family blind + board A/B adjudicate.
